answer: Allocate each reward pool by locked coin-seconds, not account count; each coin can back only one live lock. Staking 100 coins for an hour contributes 100 coin-hours even if divided among 100 keys. Pay proportionally, with no per-account minimum or rounding bonus. Agents may wander from yarrow analysis to orchard forecasting without gaining new stake-time by renaming themselves. A clone farm increases its share only by acquiring and immobilizing more capital, paying purchase and opportunity costs.
